name: Enhance Fuel System Cleaner

features.text: Can restores engine performance, power and fuel economy in one tankful.
Cleans stubborn combustion chamber and injector deposits.
Compatible with fuel system components, including oxygen sensors and catalytic converters.
can be used in all types of gasoline.
Designed for Modern GDI & High-Output Engines.

description: ENHANCE™ - Fuel System Cleaner is a super-concentrated tank additive with the most advanced detergent technology available for rapid "one-tank" clean-up of the most severe and hard-to-remove fuel deposits. Enhance effectively cleans combustion chambers, removes carbon from intake valves and restores proper flow in fuel injectors. It is specially designed to remove severe deposits typically found in Gas Direct Inject (GDI) and other modern high-output engines.
application: Pour entire contents of bottle into fuel tank. Caution: make sure tank has a minimum of eight gallons of gas. Less dilution may cause erratically-running engine during the cleaning cycle.

ad.headline: Advanced Detergents
ad.description:
Today’s GDI, hybrid and high-output engines are extremely sensitive to deposit build-up on fuel injectors, intake valves and combustion chambers. Even small amounts of deposits from inconsistent fuel quality and daily driving conditions can quickly reduce fuel economy, impact engine performance, and create drivability issues.

ENHANCE® - Fuel System Cleaner is a fast-acting deposit remover that cleans combustion chambers, intake valves and restores flow in fuel injectors. Enhance your vehicle’s power, economy, and performance today!
benefits: COMPATIBILE WITH ALL TYPES OF FUEL.
DESIGNED FOR MODERN GDI, HYBRID & HIGH-OUTPUT ENGINES.
RAPID “ONE-TANK” CLEAN-UP OF THE MOST SEVERE DEPOSITS.
